# Cycles for each 6809 and 6309 opcode as lwasm (LWTOOLS 4.25, lwasm/cycle.c, by Erik Gavriluk, checked by
# John Kowalski; BSD 3-clause or GPL) counts them in its listings: prefix and opcode, then a 6809's (or a 6309's
# in emulation mode), then a 6309's in native mode. Indexed forms are before their postbyte's extra, PSHS and the
# rest before the registers they move. http://www.lwtools.ca/
